Isometric log-ratio (pivot) coordinates of a composition

Source: R/utils_composition.R
ilr_transform.Rd

Transforms a D-part composition into D - 1 pivot ILR coordinates via robCompositions::pivotCoord(), appended to data as plain numeric columns ilr1 ... ilr{D-1}. The first coordinate expresses the pivot part relative to the geometric mean of the remaining parts. Reallocation predictions are invariant to the choice of pivot when the model is linear in the coordinates or holds their full quadratic (ilr()).

Usage

ilr_transform(data, parts, total = NULL, pivot = 1)

Arguments

data

A data frame containing the composition.

parts

Character vector of column names making up the composition (at least two parts).

total

Expected row total for the parts (e.g., 1440 for minutes in a 24-hour day). If NULL (default), row totals are not checked.

pivot

The part forming the numerator of the first coordinate: either a column name from parts or its position. Defaults to the first part.

Value

data as a tibble with length(parts) - 1 additional numeric columns named ilr1, ilr2, ....

References

Filzmoser, P., Hron, K., & Templ, M. (2018). Applied Compositional Data Analysis: With Worked Examples in R. Springer. doi:10.1007/978-3-319-96422-5

See also

Other composition helpers: check_composition(), geom_mean_comp(), ilr_backtransform(), variation_matrix()

Examples

ilr_transform(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"), total = 1440)
